title: Docs and Studio follow-up for #33614: objectstack-automation skill text and Studio connector extras repeater still offer undeclared input keys
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwhJBt274G7zk78A5a

Follow-up owed by PR #33614 (Fixes #33553, merged; review#2 record 6889245825). Since #33614, a `connector_action` input key that the action's input schema does not declare is refused at run time (unresolved `$ref` params and `$ref`/schemaless bodies read as open). Two surfaces outside the server packages still describe or offer the old behaviour. p3.

- **Skills text (governed surface).** `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` (connector_action row) and `skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md` (~l.62) are partly stale: they should say undeclared keys are refused and that a `$ref` parameter or body reads as open input. Governed: needs the approver landing path.
- **Studio.** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/connector-input-fields.ts` still offers an extras repeater for keys the run now refuses. UI lane owns this part.

Not leased to an area (cross-lane); the server seat routes it.
